faces.name: Ashiok, Dream Render
faces.oracleText:
Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause their controller to search their library.
−1: Target player mills four cards. Then exile each opponent's graveyard.

faces.name: Ashiok, Genderfear
faces.oracleText:
During your turn, you may cast cards your opponents own in exile with deceit counters on them by spending loyalty from planeswalkers you control as though it were mana of any color.
+1: Exile the top two cards of each opponents' library. Put a deceit counter on each card exiled this way.
−3: Exile target creature and put a deceit counter on it. Ashiok can be your commander.

faces.name: Ashiok, Nightmare Muse
faces.oracleText:
+1: Create a 2/3 blue and black Nightmare creature token with "Whenever this token attacks or blocks, each opponent exiles the top two cards of their library."
−3: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand, then that player exiles a card from their hand.
−7: You may cast up to three spells from among face-up cards your opponents own from exile without paying their mana costs.

faces.name: Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver
faces.oracleText:
+2: Exile the top three cards of target opponent's library.
−X: Put a creature card with mana value X exiled with Ashiok onto the battlefield under your control. That creature is a Nightmare in addition to its other types.
−10: Exile all cards from all opponents' hands and graveyards.

faces.name: Ashiok's Adept
faces.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, each opponent discards a card.

faces.name: Ashiok, Sculptor of Fears
faces.oracleText:
+2: Draw a card. Each player mills two cards.
−5: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
−11: Gain control of all creatures target opponent controls.

faces.name: Ashiok's Erasure
faces.oracleText:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, exile target spell.
Your opponents can't cast spells with the same name as the exiled card.
When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to its owner's hand.

faces.name: Ashiok's Forerunner
faces.oracleText:
Flash
When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Ashiok, Sculptor of Fears, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
